Arrival at a place raided not long ago: charred roofs, black smoke, an empty strand, seen from our ship's bow.
Arrival overland: a settlement seen from a rise across the heath, our own spears in the foreground.
After the assault: the taken settlement behind, smoke rising red in the dusk, our warriors with a banner in the foreground.

Arrival by sea at a town of the western lowlands (Albric and Cael): thatched halls inside an old earth bank at a river mouth, a small stone hall of the Lantern, fish traps and broad river boats at a wharf. Seen from our ship's bow. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.

Arrival by sea at a city of the warm south (Corvaine): old imperial stone walls patched with brick, red roofs, a stone breakwater, cypress and olive hills, a pillared hall with a gilded lantern. Seen from our ship's bow. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.

Arrival by sea at a river stronghold of the east (the Velkar Rivers): log walls on an earth rampart with a gate tower, steep-roofed log houses, dugouts on the mud bank, endless birch forest, mist on the water. Seen from our ship's bow. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.

Arrival by sea at a port of the far south (Saraleon): pale stone walls and flat-roofed houses up a dry hillside, palms, one low dome, awnings over a market by a stone quay with oared galleys. Seen from our ship's bow. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.

Arrival by sea at a camp of the grass plains (the Kurgai): round felt tents, wagons, horse herds to the horizon, horse-tail standards, riders watching from the bank by a ford. Seen from our ship's bow. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.
